source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 借势救人，少年周旋
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC18 after EP02 SC17 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from Tuobaye's shouted interruption into the deception-and-rescue beat: Chaoyang Valley mistakes him for Qingdi or a trusted attendant; Tuobaye orders Duan Yukai brought to the gate; his identity is quickly questioned; he bluff-talks to buy time; secretly aided by the white-clothed woman, he is forced to face Tang Qi's probing attack.
title: 借势救人，少年周旋

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC17 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC17 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 拓拔野怒喝住手，朝阳谷众人将他误认作青帝或青帝亲近之人。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 众人停刀后，拓拔野顺水推舟，命他们把段聿铠抬到门边并转身退下。很快十四郎与科沙度察觉不对，开始试探他的身份。拓拔野一边插科打诨拖延时间，一边给段聿铠服下神农丹。科沙度越发起疑，命唐七试招验证。白衣女子暗中传音相助，拓拔野被迫硬着头皮上场，为下一段‘借力应付试探’做铺垫。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 随后唐七虚招连试，白衣女子暗中指点；拓拔野被无形之力托起，险象环生中反成奇势。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant, restrained, and mostly still; her help should be implied through subtle gaze or invisible force later, not overt spellcasting theatrics.
Duan Yukai remains wounded but proud; once moved to the gate, he should look injured yet still dangerous.
Chaoyang Valley group remains black-clothed and suspicious. Tang Qi should feel like a probing enforcer rather than a hero lead.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.
